title: kit.copy-pack.v1
description: A module's reader-facing copy as data: a non-empty object (or list) whose leaves are strings (a locale pack, a notice pack, a table of names), nested in objects and arrays. Where the copy needs parameters it is a template function or a {placeholder} string. A module listed under `schemas` in kit.canon.json with this schema is validated data: its strings are content, and the hardcoding scan reads the same text written anywhere else as a finding.

anyOf.description: A template function (brand) => text: copy that needs parameters.
